title: CAN-SPAM Address Requirement: When a PO Box or Mailbox Counts
meta_description: CAN-SPAM accepts a street address, a USPS box or a registered private mailbox. USPS boxes start at $31 for six months; a foreign PO box is not on the list.

image.takeaway: The US spam law accepts a PO box or private mailbox only if it is registered under USPS rules in the sender’s name.
image.alt: CAN-SPAM address requirement: a street address, a USPS PO box or a private mailbox registered with a commercial mail receiving agency, in the sender’s name; the smallest USPS box costs $31 to $170 for six months
